_comment: Hero photo slider. Each slide needs 'image' (a path under images/, landscape, roughly 2000x800 or wider) and 'alt'. Optional 'heading', 'text' and a 'link' with 'linkLabel' draw a caption over the photo; leave them out for a photo-only slide. To add one: drop the file into images/photos/ and add an entry here. The slide below is WAITING ON ITS FILE - the renderer skips a slide whose image is missing, so the hero falls back to the flat gradient until the photograph is saved to the path named.

slides.alt: A Cherokee forward drives the ball past two Cherry Hill East defenders under a sunset sky
slides.heading: Friday Nights
slides.text: Cherokee and Cherry Hill East, girls soccer.
